title: Classic Greek Souvlaki
description: A traditional Greek dish made with marinated lamb skewers, perfect for a summer evening. Serve with a refreshing side of salad and pita bread.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together yogurt, lemon juice, garlic, and 2 tablespoons olive oil.
2. Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
4. Thread the marinated lamb onto the souvlaki skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
5. Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
6. Grill the souvlaki for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until browned and cooked through.
7. Meanwhile, grill the onion, tomato, and cucumber slices for 2-3 minutes per side, until tender.
8. Warm pita bread by wrapping it in foil and heating it on the grill for a few minutes.
9. Assemble the souvlaki by placing a few skewers onto each pita, followed by a few slices of onion, tomato, and cucumber.
